arabic text: JAB MUJE APKAY QATIL\nNAY HAY MARA BABA
english translation text: WHEN YOUR MURDERER BEAT ME OH FATHER

arabic text: HARTAMACHAY PAY SAKINA SA NAYPUKARA BABA
english translation text: SAKINA SCREAMED FOR HER FATHER AFTER EVERY SLAP

arabic text: MUJHAY BALON SAY PAKR KAR HAY TAMACHAY MARAY\nMAIN NAY SAR SHIMR (L) SAY MANGA JO TUMHARA BABA
english translation text: HE HELD ME BY MY HAIR AND SLAPPED ME, WHENEVER I ASKED FOR YOUR SEVERED HEAD FROM SHIMR OH FATHER

arabic text: WO JO DUR APNAY TOHFAY MAIN MUJE BAKSHAY THAY\nUNKO BEDARDI SYA ZALIM NAYUTARA BABA
english translation text: THOSE EARRINGS THAT YOU HAD GIFTED ME WITH YOUR LOVE, THEY REMOVED THEM FROM MY EARS COLD HEARTEDLY OH FATHER

arabic text: APKAY SEENAY PAY ARAM SAY SONAY WALISO KAY AB KHAK PAY KARTI HAY GUZARA BABA
english translation text: THE ONE WHO WOULD SLEEP ON YOUR CHEST SO PEACEFULLY, IS BEING FORCED TO LIVE BY SLEEPING ON THE SAND OH FATHER

arabic text: SATH RAHWARON KAY DORAYA GAYA HAY MUJH KO
english translation text: CHOOR ZAKHMONG SAY BADAN MERAHAY SARA BABA\nI HAVE BEEN PARADED TOGETHER WITH THE HORSES, MY ENTIRE BODY IS BRUISED WITH INJURIES OH FATHER

arabic text: NOK E NEEZA PAY ISAY DAIKHON TO DAIKHON KESAY\nMERA ASGAR AS THA MUJE JAN SAY PYARA BABA
english translation text: AT THE TIP OF A SPEAR I SEE HIM, HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO? MY ASGHAR WAS MORE BELOVED TO ME THAN MY OWN LIFE OH FATHER
